description: Job Title: Sr Mechanical Analyst – Structural and Thermal Analysis! Job Description This role provides technical leadership in mechanical analysis for complex electronic systems across a broad portfolio of aerospace, defense, intelligence, cyber, and space programs. You will perform high-quality structural and thermal analyses, guide design optimization, and support both local and remote programs. The position offers the opportunity to work with advanced technologies, collaborate with multidisciplinary teams, and contribute directly to mission-critical systems that support national security and public safety. Responsibilities Provide technical leadership and deliver high-quality mechanical analysis support to locally based programs as well as other programs across the broader electronic systems portfolio, including remote support as needed. Plan, coordinate, and execute analysis activities in collaboration with program engineers and program leadership, ensuring alignment with technical requirements, schedules, and program objectives. Perform structural analyses using both classical hand-calculation methods and finite element methods to evaluate modal response, random vibration, shock, and static structural performance. Perform thermal analyses, including steady-state and transient heat transfer evaluations, to ensure robust thermal performance and compliance with requirements. Create detailed finite element models (FEM) at levels ranging from sub-components to full system assemblies using Siemens Simcenter 3D/NX, NASTRAN, Ansys Mechanical, and Ansys Icepak. Post-process and interpret finite element analysis results to assess structural and thermal performance, identify risks, and propose design improvements. Collaborate closely with mechanical, electrical, optical, and other engineering disciplines to optimize system designs and ensure robust, integrated solutions across the full product portfolio. Document analysis methods, assumptions, models, results, and conclusions in clear, professional reports and presentations suitable for internal and external stakeholders. Present analysis findings, design recommendations, and risk assessments to internal teams and external customers in a clear and concise manner. Mentor and coach less experienced engineers and part-time analysts, providing technical guidance, feedback, and support to help develop their skills. Review analysis work products from other team members to ensure technical accuracy, completeness, and adherence to standards and best practices. Contribute to a collaborative, inclusive team culture by communicating effectively, maintaining a positive attitude, and supporting cross-functional teamwork. Essential Skills Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or Aerospace Engineering. At least 4 years of relevant experience in mechanical analysis or a closely related field.
